assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon,本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束,仅用于内容设计与机器校验;官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 容积率、建筑高度、道路红线与绿线管理等法定控制条件未知,本方案不给出任何具体数值结论,环线线位仅为概念示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory controls (FAR, height, road redlines) are unknown; this proposal makes no numeric conclusions and the loop alignment is conceptual only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 骑行流量、轨道客流与慢行需求数据未公开,环线断面、借还与驿站规模的推导仅作概念情景,不构成容量或投资结论。
assumptions.statement_en: Cycling demand, rail ridership and slow-traffic data are not public; loop cross-section, bike-share and station sizing are conceptual scenarios only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 驿站、借还点、安全提示与导视设施均为原创概念建议,指向示范性、可逆化的模块化设施,不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Stations, bike-share docks, safety aids and wayfinding are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 骑行轨迹与人流数据仅以匿名聚合与人工复核兜底,不设个体识别采集,不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Ride trajectory and crowd data use anonymous aggregation with human review; no individual identification or irreversible automated decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 年度骑行活动体系与驿站运营机制均为建议性设计,不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The annual ride event system and station operation mechanisms are design suggestions, not confirmed government arrangements.
